name: 30.5_phase2_baseline_vague_destination
description: P0 Phase-2 baseline (#1053): the prompt at itinerary_agent.py:195-199 says don't accept vague destinations, but empirically the bot today already suggests a concrete one (e.g. Cancún for 'somewhere warm') and asks for dates. This locks the observed current behavior — the bot must NOT immediately ship a full itinerary on a vague destination without first asking at least one follow-up. Phase 2 (O11 — suggest with a confirmation chip) refines this further.
